display.purpose: Hero headlines and major tournament titles.

body.purpose: Article text, commentary, and general UI descriptions.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The Zero-Shadow Rule: depth is achieved through tonal contrast and hairline borders rather than drop shadows.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Standard UI color and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tactile, pill-soft control with confident press cobalt background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background-color: var(--ed-blue, #2452c2); padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Flat, paper-crisp module with distinct hairline header and no shadow.
components.html:
ROUND 1 · MATCH 4LIVE

GodLike Esports claims WWCD with 14 finishes.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-hair, #e0e6ee); background-color: var(--ed-surface, #ffffff); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-hair, #e0e6ee); padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ed-stone, #64748b); } .ds-kicker { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ed-magenta, #cd2f7b); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ed-ink, #161a22); margin: 0; }

components.name: Editorial Chip
components.description: Compact 8px hairline tag for status indicators and filter controls.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-hair, #e0e6ee); background-color: var(--ed-surface, #ffffff); padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ed-ink, #161a22); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Quiet, high-legibility input with subtle hairline border and cobalt focus ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="Search players, teams, tournaments..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-hair, #e0e6ee); background-color: var(--ed-surface, #ffffff); padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ed-ink, #161a22); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ed-stone, #64748b); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ed-blue, #2452c2); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Clean tab navigation link with persistent cobalt active underline.
components.css: .ds-tab-strip { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-hair, #e0e6ee); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 2px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ed-stone, #64748b); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ed-ink, #161a22); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--ed-blue, #2452c2); border-bottom-color: var(--ed-blue, #2452c2); }

components.name: Live Pulse Indicator
components.description: Pill indicator with subtle broadcast pulse for active tournament matches.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: rgba(205, 47, 123, 0.1); color: var(--ed-magenta, #cd2f7b); padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: var(--ed-magenta, #cd2f7b); animation: ds-pulse 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.9); } }

narrative.overview:
eSportsAmaze is structured as a calm, authoritative sports journalism desk rather than a chaotic gaming portal or dark flashy dashboard. Inspired by the editorial restraint of premium publications and broadcast control rooms, the interface treats esports statistics with the dignity of top-flight athletics. Clean paper-tinted surfaces replace harsh pure whites and muddy darks; crisp slate ink anchors long-form reading and dense tables; and one confident, high-clarity Press Cobalt commands interactive attention.

The visual atmosphere balances editorial breathing room with high tabular density. Data tables, standings matrices, and match scorecards are presented with razor-sharp micro-typography and hairline separation, completely eliminating fuzzy box shadows and neon glow effects. Broadcast energy is channeled selectively through pulse badges and Editorial Crimson highlights on live tournaments.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Paper Canvas: Quiet, tinted backgrounds that allow dense data grids and team marks to stand out naturally.
Zero Drop Shadows: Structural hierarchy and depth conveyed strictly via tonal paper contrast and crisp 1px hairline dividers.
Press Cobalt Focal Points: The primary blue accent is guarded strictly for actionable controls, primary CTAs, and active navigation states.
Tabular Precision: Monospace-aligned numerical figures (tabular-nums) paired with wide-tracked micro-labels (tracking-wider).
Tactile Soft Controls: Distinctive pill-shaped buttons (16px radius) that introduce an approachable, human balance to rigid grid tables.

rules.name: The Rare Blue Rule
rules.body: Press Cobalt is reserved for actionable touchpoints and active state indicators. It should cover less than 8% of any given viewport; its rarity is what makes the interface instantly scanable.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never introduce pure #000000 or sterile #ffffff canvas backgrounds. Every neutral carries a minute slate or paper undertone to prevent harsh eye strain during extended match tracking.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: All numerical points, finish tallies, match times, and rankings metrics must apply tabular-nums font-semibold (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Non-tabular figures in data columns are strictly forbidden.

rules.name: The Editorial Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section titles and featured groupings should be preceded by an uppercase, wide-tracked micro-kicker in Slate Stone to establish immediate context before the primary headline.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are completely flat at rest. Depth is established through tonal paper contrast and hairline boundaries. Avoid ambient drop shadows, blurred glows, and inset bevels.

dos: Do preserve the 1px hairline border strategy (--ed-hair) for all card, table, and header demarcations.
Do use tabular-nums on all statistical columns, point tables, and match countdown timers.
Do respect the 1320px maximum layout width (--page-max-width) across all public pages.
Do reserve Press Cobalt for actionable links, primary buttons, and active tabs.
Do use horizontal snap rails (.rail) on mobile screens to keep large data matrices accessible without causing full-page sideways scroll.
donts: Don't add heavy drop shadows, neon box-shadows, or blurred card glows.
Don't use pure #000000 or #ffffff backgrounds without the editorial cool-paper undertones.
Don't saturate entire cards or section backgrounds in solid bright colors.
Don't mix multiple conflicting accent colors in the same view; keep accents focused to Press Cobalt and occasional Editorial Crimson.
Don't render non-tabular numbers in standings, scorecards, or rankings matrices.
